summary: Fase 2 (textual copy) verification across Landing, Login, Register, SuperAdmin/Admin/Student layouts and Student Dashboard + Certificates. All Aptiva brand strings, navigation labels and footers render exactly as specified. Auth flow for SuperAdmin, Admin and Worker still redirects to correct dashboards (no regressions).
critical_code_review_comments: Landing.js declares BACKEND_URL via process.env (good). Brand strings, 6 feature cards (incl. 'Ruta Aptiva'), 'Cómo funciona Aptiva' + 3 steps and footer match spec.
Login.js (line 80) and Register.js (line 126) descriptions render the exact F2 copy. Footers show '© <year> DoSoft · Aptiva'.

AdminLayout.js shows 'Panel Aptiva — Administración' in both mobile + desktop top bar; footer matches spec; all 12 sidebar items present (Dashboard, Trabajadores, Importar Trabajadores, Áreas, Actividades, Cursos, Evaluaciones, Tipos de Documentos, Expedientes, Certificados, Reportes, Branding).
StudentLayout.js navItems now show 'Mi Ruta Aptiva' and 'Mis Constancias'. Footer matches spec.
Student Dashboard heading 'Mi Ruta Aptiva' replaces former 'Mis Cursos'; empty-state copy 'Aún no tienes capacitaciones asignadas en tu ruta' present.
Student Certificates page heading 'Mis Constancias' present.
public/index.html <title> = 'Aptiva — Competencias, Capacitaciones y Storage de Trabajadores' and OG/meta description aligned with brand.

Minor (non-blocking): Console log shows 'Failed to load resource: 404' for two assets on /login (likely favicon variants or branding logo missing). Not a functional bug but worth checking favicon-32x32.png?v=3 / logo192.png?v=3 paths in /public.
Minor (non-blocking): SuperAdmin dashboard logs 'Error fetching stats: TypeError: Failed to fetch'. Out of F2 scope but flagged for the main agent.
test_credentials: From /app/memory/test_credentials.md — superadmin@aptiva.com/superadmin123, admin@aptivademo.com/admin123, trabajador@aptivademo.com/trabajador123. All three login flows work and redirect to /superadmin, /admin, /student respectively.
context_for_next_testing_agent: F2 textual copy update is fully verified live on https://user-credentials-6.preview.emergentagent.com. The Playwright run confirmed: Landing title/badge/hero/subtitle/6 features/3 steps/footer; Login + Register card copy and footers; Admin top bar 'Panel Aptiva — Administración' + sidebar items + footer; SuperAdmin footer; Student nav 'Mi Ruta Aptiva' + 'Mis Constancias', section heading 'Mi Ruta Aptiva' (no 'Mis Cursos'), Certificates page heading 'Mis Constancias'. Two prior console errors observed but unrelated to F2: (1) 404s for static logo/favicon on /login; (2) SuperAdmin stats fetch error. Both can be investigated in a future iteration.
rca of the issue:
No regression or bug detected. Two initial false-negative selector failures (Login/Register description) were caused by CardDescription rendering as a div not a

. A direct text_content() on the parent card confirmed both descriptions are rendered exactly as specified.
